mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the federal funds rate is above 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the unemployment rate is below 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts and a decline in the unemployment rate signal a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when housing starts are strong and the unemployment rate is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% and a decline in the consumer price index signal a tightening monetary cycle with low inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with low inflation
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and the consumer price index is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate signal a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when payroll employment is strong and the unemployment rate is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales and a decline in the unemployment rate signal a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when retail sales are strong and the unemployment rate is low (t-test p > 0.05).
